questions.question: When Paul and Barnabas spoke in the synagogue at Iconium, what happened?

answers.text: A great number of Jews and Greeks believed
The leaders asked them to preach every Sabbath
The rulers invited them to speak at the palace

questions.question: In Lystra, Paul called out "Stand up on your feet!" to a man who had never walked. What did the man do?

answers.text: Jumped up and began to walk
Stood but could not take a step
Asked Paul to pray for him first

questions.question: In Lystra, some Jews stoned Paul and dragged him out of the city, thinking he was dead. True or false?
After their journey, Paul and Barnabas told the church God had opened the door of faith to whom?
